The India Meteorological Department has issued warnings to fishermen to avoid certain areas. Rainfall is anticipated to increase, particularly on Monday and Tuesday. ([The Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/bay-of-bengal-deep-depression-moves-closer-to-tamil-nadu-imd-warns-of-strong-winds-up-to-75kmph-rain-likely-over-next-two-days/articleshow/135420570.cms))
